name: Tilt-in Panel
description: A large framed panel under a heading that starts tilted away and lies flat as the page scrolls it into place.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading block above the frame. It drifts up as you scroll; bring your own heading element.

props.name: children
props.description: What sits in the frame, clipped to its rounded corners. A wide image or a screenshot of your app.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer section.
